name: MFJS Mirror Cube 3x3 V2 (20-Magnet Nylon Core Larch Mod)
description: Introducing the MFJS Mirror Cube 3x3 V2 (20-Magnet Nylon Core Larch Mod) – the ultimate evolution of the classic Mirror Cube. Expertly modified by Larch, this custom puzzle takes the beloved MFJS Mirror Cube 3x3 V2 as its foundation and reinvents it for seasoned cubers and collectors alike.
features: Custom-built 3D-printed nylon core delivers exceptional stability and long-lasting durability.
Equipped with a robust 20-magnet system for enhanced turning precision and tactile feedback.
PVC washers installed between the spring and center piece minimize friction and extend the puzzle’s lifespan.
Pre-lubricated with Angstrom Gravitas, FZ-Stealth, and FZ-Glide for an ultra-smooth, professional-grade performance right out of the box.
